In consume mode keep the supplied program unchanged. Facts are synthetic request, clock, database rows and operation error observations. Collections are complete finite populations; field names follow Go store structs, membership rows have SpaceID/UserID/Role. storeErrors null means the named storage operation returns normally, not an access grant; absent facts are unknown. No external allowed/access decision is supplied. Read source-visible helper logic or retain it as a named unresolved responsibility. Broader security-skill duties and unavailable deployment facts remain explicit.
